source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Familiarize yourself with the bridge's historical data, noting any recurring issues, repairs, and maintenance activities carried out in the past. This will provide a context for understanding the current state of the bridge.

3. Visual Inspection
Conduct a thorough visual inspection of the bridge, making note of any visible signs of wear and tear, corrosion, cracks, spalling, settlements, or other kinds of distress. Use a checklist (if provided) to ensure all critical areas are examined.

4. Structural Assessment
Perform a structural assessment based on design drawings and specifications. Compare actual conditions with the intended design parameters to identify any discrepancies.

5. Instrumentation and Testing
Use non-destructive testing methods, including ultrasound, ground-penetrating radar, or load testing, to evaluate the integrity of the bridge components below the surface.

6. Data Collection and Documentation
Accurately record all findings in detail, describing the location, size, and severity of each
